text: The author employs a third-person omniscient point of view, focusing on the detective’s narration while simultaneously offering an external evaluation of his methods. The tone is analytical and appreciative, characterized by a sense of admiration for the detective’s "meticulous attention to detail" and "clinical detachment." The style is formal and descriptive, using precise adjectives to highlight the contrast between the objective, straightforward language of the detective and the inherent drama of the storyline.
